undeclared.decision: Token error is a single relative L2 norm over main embeddings and all DeepStack outputs, normalized by the computed output's total squared norm, with a 1e-12 denominator floor.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-010 declares a relative error bound without defining its aggregation or reference. The implemented metric permits individual tokens or layers to exceed the configured tolerance when the aggregate passes.

undeclared.decision: Both motion and residual thresholds default to zero.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The ledger specifies the comparisons and the token-error default, but not these defaults. Merely supplying a sidecar leaves positive motion or residual candidates ineligible.

undeclared.decision: Anchor comparison occurs only on a cache miss and only if the nominated anchor already exists in the same store. An exact record saved before its anchor becomes available is not reconsidered on later hits.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Anchor availability and access order determine which candidates become aliases. A-003/A-006/A-010 do not declare this one-time eligibility policy.

undeclared.decision: An accepted anchor replaces the freshly computed output in the validating request itself.
undeclared.why_it_matters: With nonzero tolerance, approximation affects the first request as well as subsequent requests. A-010 explicitly describes subsequent reuse but leaves the validating request's returned output unspecified.

undeclared.decision: The spawned engine enables the hook only when AVA_VIT_TOKEN_CACHE_DIR is explicitly present.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The installer provides a default cache directory, but the bootstrap does not use that default to activate caching. The effective environment requirement is absent from the specification and ledger.

undeclared.decision: Counters reset for each store instance; hits and misses count visual segments, while vit_calls counts batched original-forward invocations. The metrics file contains the current instance's snapshot.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The persistent records survive restarts, but their counters do not. These units and lifetime determine how the exposed counters can substantiate cross-query reuse.

stale_rows.actual_behavior: Production installation attempts the imported Qwen3-VL implementation and checks selected input/output structures during execution. The explicit forward-signature assertion exists only in the integration test; production has no version compatibility gate.
stale_rows.why_it_matters: The row promises version rejection beyond the structural checks implemented.
